name: MVGS_CS_HOSPITALIZATION_DURATION
title: MV-GenomSeq hospitalisation duration (banded days)
description: Estimated total duration in days of case-relevant inpatient pre-treatment, banded as delivered by the BfArM Datenkranz (KDK rare disease case.priorRds[].hospitalizationDuration). Interim until the Seltene module ships a concept (ballot comment HDB-975; DISCUSS-TD #33, REPRESENTATIONS #33). Band codes are the KDK literals; 'unknown' is not a code (Observation.dataAbsentReason). The concept 'hospitalization-duration' is the Observation.code; it is not part of the value set mvgs-vs-hospitalization-duration (band codes only), so CodeSystem.valueSet (whole code system) is not set.

concept.display: Duration of case-relevant inpatient pre-treatment (days, banded)
concept.definition: Estimated total number of days of inpatient treatment related to the rare disease before the current case (KDK hospitalizationDuration).
